headline: Disorganized back line vulnerable
body: At minute 54, Portugal 2–1 Spain, ball zone away_attack, the away team is attacking near the goal, leaving a disorganized back line vulnerable to counter-attacks during slow transition.
action: Compact shape immediately and cover defensive half-spaces
